description: Remove Frame Conn's hard-coded mission-scale Overcharge heat progression while preserving its turn-scale Overcharge state and UI model.
planning_goal: Frame Conn Turn state must continue to own once-per-turn Overcharge availability and the granted Quick Action, but it must no longer calculate the escalating Overcharge heat sequence. The heat formula stored for presentation must be supplied by the native Lancer actor execution path, so native actor state remains authoritative for mission-scale Overcharge progression and modified Overcharge sequences.
